title: Onboard helia-13b-v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Asha Menon
description:
Onboard helia-13b v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata, performance profiles for common serving targets, and automation to insert generated release notes into the changelog. Motivation: helia-13b is a lightweight, instruction-tuned model that gives a strong price/latency tradeoff for mid-range customer workloads. This PR registers the model, adds validated perf profiles measured across representative sequence lengths and batch sizes, and updates the changelog generator so release notes for new model onboards are automatically created from perf metadata.

What this PR includes: 
- models/helia/metadata.json: canonical metadata (model name, version, architecture, tokenizer, weights source, license, recommended quantization flags, supported sequence lengths, feature flags).
- perf/profiles/helia-13b-v1.0.yaml: performance profiles with measured throughput (tokens/s), p50/p95 latency for seq_len of 128/512/2048, on GPU targets A100-40GB (bf16), T4-16GB (int8), and CPU reference. Includes guidance fields used by serving runtime to pick quantization and batching defaults.
- scripts/generate-changelog.py: extended to consume perf profile files and render a standardized release note fragment (including throughput table and known caveats). Updated unit tests and added an integration smoke test.
- docs/models/helia.md: short quickstart and recommended deploy config (batching, kv-cache settings, quantization profiles).
- tests/test_helia_profiles.py: validates schema, numeric ranges, and that generated changelog contains required sections.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add model metadata JSON with provenance and license info.
- [x] Add perf profiles measured against curated harness and record measurement metadata (commit, seeds).
- [x] Update changelog generator to include perf-based release notes.
- [x] Add tests for profile schema and changelog generation.
- [x] CI green and manual spot-check of generated notes.

Testing and validation: perf numbers were produced by the benchmark-lab harness (Linear ENG-2281). Measurements are reproducible; raw CSVs and harness run IDs are linked in the metadata file. All unit tests pass in CI; changelog generation included a smoke run that produced the expected markdown fragment inserted into CHANGELOG/_auto/helia-13b-v1.0.md.

Notes for reviewers: pay special attention to the recommended quantization flags for T4 int8 and the thresholds chosen for autoscaling hints. The changelog generator change is additive and guarded; it only writes auto-generated fragments into the _auto directory and will not overwrite manual release notes.

Related: linear ENG-2281, ENG-2290 (perf sanity checks), SUP-1198 (customer request for Helia on Dedicated).
